gen-vast-shadow-gf-mada: Mada leaves its curves open and lets its lowercase tower, so text feels friendly and modern under the vintage Vast Shadow. The pull is a loud uniform-stroke heading against a gentle body.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-martian-mono: Vast Shadow draws loud, vintage letters with generous space around each one. It grabs the eye, while Martian Mono, a monospace, quietly sets fixed-width, code-style letters with loose spacing and a structured feel.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-montserrat-underline: Montserrat Underline is a sans-serif with breathing counters and lowercase that looks oversized beside its capitals. But Vast Shadow is built to grab the eye, while Montserrat Underline is built to carry the words.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-mozilla-headline: Vast Shadow gives its round letters walls matching the straight ones. Mozilla Headline, a sans-serif with big-bodied lowercase and a splayed c terminal, keeps paragraphs feeling approachable and contemporary as they run on.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-mozilla-text: Loud, vintage lettering from Vast Shadow, where stems match hairlines because there are none. And Mozilla Text steps in with tall-bodied, bold-looking lowercase and flared terminals, so the sans-serif body anchors the page.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-nobile: Nobile reads crisp and contemporary, with open letter mouths and capitals sitting barely above the lowercase. But after the laser-cut look of Vast Shadow, extended text moves along smoothly and steadily.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-nokora: Vast Shadow gives its horizontal bars exactly the weight of its upright stems, a vintage, eye-catching look. And Nokora adds a friendly plain sans texture, its s never tightening and its lowercase forming a dark stripe.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Vintage first: Vast Shadow draws every stroke without brush-style swell. Then Noto Kufi Arabic, a sans with an inviting gap in the c, carries longer text with modern, clean ease.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans: Sign-painter swagger in single-stroke lines: Vast Shadow keeps a constant width and a tall, vintage stance. Noto Sans simply gets on with the reading, its lowercase tall and open.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Vast Shadow glows like neon glass tubing, vintage and eye-catching. It is made to stop a glance, while Noto Sans Adlam, a sans-serif with well-spaced curve endings, is made to be read.
